Name: Garden Pots Galore
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
Almost immediately after hitting publish on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34217]Dwarf Fruit Trees[/url], I regretted adding in the Garden Pot edits. Once I realised I was going to need to upload a second version to fix some sprite misalignment, the decision was made-- I expanded on the initial one texture option and one crafting recipe option and this is the result.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34240/34240-1749855195-1840224526.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]Adds in 11 options for Garden Pot retextures (12, if you count Vanilla as an option). All are aligned correctly with a 12x11 pixel dirt patch, so no worries about your trellis crops hanging over the sides.[/*]
[*]Adds in 5 options for Garden Pot crafting recipes (6, if... as above). Built to match thematically with the modified textures. Yay, immersion![/*]
[*]Both settings can be changed mid-game without issue (unconfirmed in multiplayer, though as always it's recommended that all players match).[/*]
[*]Does not change how or when Garden Pots are unlocked, and does not interfere with any of their functionality, thus retaining compatibility with mechanical changes to pots that don't also modify textures/recipes for them.[/*]
[/list]
This mod is included in the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Small Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34240/34240-1749855201-1831469381.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional, but recommended)[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34240/34240-1749855206-989855023.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Garden Pots Galore[/b] to your mods folder.[/*]
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into MO2 and install as usual.[/*]
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34240/34240-1749855213-1005856202.png[/img][/center]

[b]Garden Pot Appearance
[/b][i]Select a texture for your Garden Pots (see comparison image). Default: PotTall.[/i]
[list]
[*]I = Vanilla/Disabled[/*]
[*]II = VanillaPlus[/*]
[*]III = BasketLight[/*]
[*]IV = BasketDark[/*]
[*]V = Stump[/*]
[*]VI = PotShort[/*]
[*]VII = PotTall[/*]
[*]VIII = PotFancy[/*]
[*]IX = PlanterWoodBrown[/*]
[*]X = PlanterWoodGreen[/*]
[*]XI = PlanterWoodStripes[/*]
[*]XII = PlanterFancy[/*]
[/list]
[b]Garden Pot Crafting Recipe[/b]
[i]Select a crafting recipe for your Garden Pots. Default: Pot.[/i]
[list]
[*]Vanilla: 1 Clay, 10 Stone, 1 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]Pot: 5 Clay, 10 Stone, 1 Basic Fertilizer[/*]
[*]Basket: 20 Fiber, 10 Wood, 1 Basic Fertilizer[/*]
[*]Planter: 1 Hardwood, 20 Wood, 1 Basic Fertilizer[/*]
[*]Stump: 5 Hardwood, 1 Basic Fertilizer[/*]
[*]PlanterFancy: 1 Iron Bar, 1 Refined Quartz, 1 Basic Fertilizer[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34240/34240-1749855221-294653363.png[/img][/center]

Explicitly compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21608]Garden Pot Options[/url]. Not compatible with other mods that change the appearance of Garden Pots.
